answer: Transaction Co-occurrence Lattice monitors which identities transact within the same short windows. A cluster of accounts repeatedly appearing together forms a detectable vine of correlated activity. When coordination exceeds the baseline rate seen in organic traffic, the whole group is flagged and its members' future transactions get held for review. Attackers must spread operations across unrelated timing patterns, or scatter wallets like an oasis in a tundra of inactivity, paying real coordination overhead per identity.
